writeup: Woot has a staff-only open-box listing of the Sammic XM-72 commercial stick immersion blender for $370.80. Cresco Resco currently lists the matching XM-72 new at $1,146 with pickup availability in Denver and Fresno, usually ready in 2–4 days. That is 67% below, or about $775 off the live Cresco Resco price. Woot shows 2+ left, with a limit of 2 per customer.
